title: This is why I have officially stopped caring about Reddit game dev communities
author: PoopsMcScoots
selftext:
I’m not stupid and I know these things are kiss asses, but I always try to get genuine feedback and ask for pushback, because I actually am working on things.

But JFC, are people on Reddit insufferable trying to discuss anything at all.

I just can’t do it anymore with people in the community.

It’s a giant toxic sludge puddle and the most innocuous of questions end ends up being a fucking rabbit hole of arguing with assholes who are deliberately missing your point.

And then they’ll jump all over you cackling, and down voting.

I’m just so fucking done with it.

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body: lol no. there's no motivation system that optimizes for sycophancy. What you're talking about is goal orientation during inference, that's completely defined by the parameters of hte conversation. YOu can literally just ask it not to do that. During training / alignment nothing optimizes toward user satisfaction, and that's deliberate. source; I'm an MLE at an AI lab.

Yes.

replies.body: To be fair, wading through to find the 5% real answers is better than a suck-up answer an AI will give.

replies.author: PoopsMcScoots
replies.body:
Yes, ai sucks up (especially ChatGPT) but if I’m exploring an idea I’d rather deal with the ass kissing than the trolls.

And I’m actually trying to accomplish something.

If I ask an AI “I’m thinking of this mechanic in a game” it’ll give me a list of games that are similar and other actual useful information.
